  output     [DW-1:0] qout,

  input               clk,
  input               rst_n

reg [DW-1:0] qout_r;

always @(posedge clk or negedge rst_n)
begin : DFFRS_PROC

    qout_r <= {DW{1'b1}};
  else                  
    qout_r <= #1 dnxt;
end
